claims.text: For every fixed p<1, deterministic zero-query expected O_p(log^2 n) path with aspect-independent every-execution n^{O_p(log n)} exact operations.
Bateni et al. introduced the strong/weak distance-oracle framework; their square-root-log MST upper theorem assumes metric weak observations.
Anand et al. give unrestricted-time O_p(log n) for every p<1 and quasipolynomial O(log^4 n) for p<=0.1.
Hierarchy, universal future tests, normalization and promotion/intersection framework are inherited from Anand et al. Section 6.
Fletcher-Hershkowitz graph-spanning distance embeddings have constant distortion under level-diameter growth Omega(log n); present objective is dyadic total path cost with hidden cores.
r<=81q^-2 ell, R<=11000q^-3 ell, r/R<=q/128; n=2 and R>n paths meet main bound.
Uniform unmarked-rectangle mask failure probability <n^-20, also for adaptive observations.
Every observed R-seed has a hidden true 2s-radius core of size at least R-r.
Ceiling-rank quantiles bound point-center and seed-center distances, with fewer than r universally far accepted points.
Observable finite carving creates nested partitions and always outputs a spanning path.
Points within (A-2)t pass singleton tests; every true-diameter-t R-set is admissible.
Every intermediate nonsingleton has diameter<=256t core, size>r, fewer than r outliers; singleton core may be empty.
Selected centers are >28t apart; k separated points satisfy k<=1+2MST/delta.
K_i<=1+W*/t_i; N_i<=(R-1)(1+4W*/t_i); partition count<=R+4RW*/t_i.
Actual intermediate outlier count<=2R+5RW*/t_i; bottom n, root zero.
Under normalized scale bounds, H and Omega each <=14R(L+1)W*.
Every compatible DFS path costs <=2 beta H+12 beta Omega under the stated nonnested-core assumptions.
Constructed normalized path cost<=50176R(L+1)W*.
Scale-event failure probability<=p^(n-1), uniformly over adversary.
d* is genuine metric, D*<=d*, equality on unmarked pairs; Delta* in [n^2/2,n^2] on scale event.
Scaling good-event cost<=100352R(L+1)W, failure contribution<=(1+1/q)W.
Observable precomputation uses O(L^2 n N^2) plus polynomial factors; c_q n^{2R+k}<=n^{a_q h}; zero private-bit cost.
358 nested chains on five labels, 8951 eligible core assignments for (1,2),(2,3), 268560 compatible ordered cases, 1074240 path edges.
Finite checks concern extraction and do not execute the large-constant carving algorithm or replace all-n proof.
Substantial Codex assistance for proofs, algorithms, exact code, literature and drafting; separate model contexts checked internally.

scope: Entire manuscript, including all substantive theorem/lemma/bound assertions, cited comparisons, finite-count evidence and disclosure. Definitions, questions and expressly future work excluded. User authorized bounded autonomous release; no additional confirmation pause.
